component.name: FastIpSwitch
component.summary: Switch IPv4 addresses and manage virtual IPs

description.p: FastIpSwitch changes the IPv4 configuration of a network interface between DHCP and a static address, and manages temporary virtual addresses (aliases) on the same interface.

ul.li: Read adapters and their current addresses at a glance.
Apply a static address, gateway and DNS servers in one action.
Add or remove virtual IPs without dropping DHCP.
Restore the initial configuration when the application quits.
Light and dark themes, English and French interface.

description.p: Network changes are performed by a small privileged helper launched through pkexec and restricted by a polkit action, so the graphical application itself runs unprivileged.
